author: The Current
description:
Bad Bad Hats' Kerry Alexander talks about her new project, a supergroup called Megasound
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Kerry Alexander (Bad Bad Hats) visited The Current to talk about her new project, Megasound, a band that consists of Alexander, her Bad Bad Hats bandmate Chris Hoge, and Party Nails singer Elana Carroll. “It is, ultimately, Megasound summer,” Alexander says.

Megasound have already released the single, “Supersize,” and their self-titled debut album is set to drop on Friday, Aug. 7, on @dongiovannirecords. “If you're a Bad Bad Hats fan,” Alexander says, “you’ll get similar enjoyment out of Megasound.”

Megasound are the Local Show’s Artists of the Month, and they’re set to perform at the Turf Club in St. Paul on Friday, Aug. 14. Find more information at thecurrent.org/giglist
